comment: MLS covered_frontier cell vectors per spec authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §7.5 + extensions/mls-binding.md §3.3 (covered_frontier or-set, MLS commit Move attestation, governance-Move bypass). The covered_frontier cell is `cx:cell:cx.component.mls.covered_frontier.v1:<space_id>`, an or-set keyed by space_id that accumulates governance-frontier event refs each MLS commit attests to. Add-only growth is the typical pattern; rotation/removal is rare and gated by capability. E2EE message Moves MUST carry a `covered_frontier` precondition (or attestation) — without it the Move is rejected with `fail_precondition`. Governance Moves (non-MLS) are NOT blocked; they continue to grow the frontier so subsequent MLS commits attest to a fresh ref.

vectors.name: covered_frontier_accumulates_governance_refs_idempotent
vectors.comment: Two MLS commits attest to overlapping governance frontier refs; the or-set surfaces the union without bottom. A duplicate add (same tag, different anchored move_id) MUST be idempotent — no Bottom, no double-count.

expected.rationale: or-set: idempotent re-add (third op tags the same ref) MUST resolve to a 2-element set, not 3.

vectors.name: rotation_removes_old_ref_keeps_others
vectors.comment: After an MLS epoch rotation, a new commit adds a fresh ref; a remove for an old ref is causally LATER (the rotation Move's anchored move_id is later in deterministic order). The OR-Set is causal — the remove erases ONLY the matching prior add. The remaining governance ref MUST stay visible.

expected.rationale: Causal or-set remove drops the rotated ref; the unrelated add survives.

vectors.name: governance_move_not_blocked_by_covered_frontier
vectors.comment: A governance Move (cx.space.policy / cx.policy.set / etc.) does NOT carry a `covered_frontier` precondition — it grows the frontier rather than attesting to it. The Move is admitted unconditionally; subsequent MLS commits will pick the new ref up.

expected.rationale: Governance Moves are unrestricted by the covered_frontier; they ARE the frontier. MLS commits subsequent to this Move MUST attest to its move_id in covered_frontier.

vectors.name: mls_commit_attests_three_cells_in_one_move
vectors.comment: An MLS commit Move writes to THREE cells in one anchored op: (a) covered_frontier (or_set_add of the governance ref), (b) mls_epoch (cas-register set of the new epoch_id), (c) mls_state (whatever the SDK pinned). All three writes share the same move_id; the lattice resolves each cell independently.

expected.rationale: Three independent cells written by a single Move; each lattice resolves to Value. Atomicity is at the Move level, not the cell level.

negative_vectors.name: e2ee_message_missing_covered_frontier_precondition_rejected
negative_vectors.comment: An E2EE message Move (cx.message.send carrying ciphertext) MUST declare a `covered_frontier` precondition naming the governance ref the sender's MLS epoch attests to. A Move missing this precondition (or naming a stale ref) is rejected with `fail_precondition`.

expected.rationale: v1 wire requires every E2EE message Move to attest to a governance frontier ref via the covered_frontier precondition.

negative_vectors.name: e2ee_message_with_stale_covered_frontier_ref_rejected
negative_vectors.comment: E2EE message declares covered_frontier attesting to gov_ref X, but the cell's active_tags don't contain X (X was rotated out). Reject with `fail_precondition` + `covered_frontier_stale`.

expected.rationale: Attested ref is not in active_tags — caller's MLS epoch is stale, force re-key.
